svg.text: owner: Cloud CoE · CISO approves policy changes
Intermediate-root policies (inherited everywhere): allowed regions (East US 2, Central
US; West Europe for EU datasets) · customer-managed keys for PHI-tagged data · TLS ≥
1.2 · diagnostics to central Log Analytics · Defender for Cloud plans on · mandatory tags
Deny: user-defined routes bypassing the firewall
Deny public endpoints & public IPs · Private Link
Ingress only via Front Door + WAF →
Standard baseline · Arc-enabled servers governed by
Subscriptions are the unit of isolation and billing; new hospitals or projects receive pre-governed subscriptions through landing-zone vending (Bicep/Terraform), inheriting every policy above.
